post.description: Check whether a proposed Utah business name is already taken or close to an existing registration.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
The registry's Name Availability Search for a proposed business name: the registry's verdict flags (prohibited words, no exact match) and the list of existing records it considers conflicting or similar (record number, name, record type, status, status detail, date the name was registered, with the record's business_id). An empty record list means the registry found nothing similar.

The response contains the tool result directly.

post.description: Find Utah entities by name, entity number, principal or registered agent and get their business_id for the detail functions.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

entity_number.description: Public entity number in the registry's full form `<digits>-<4 digits>` (e.g. 12470848-0160). A bare business_id returned no records during reconnaissance.

entity_type.description: Entity type key from list_lookup_values(kind: entity_types), e.g. B7 (Domestic Limited Liability Company), B10104 (Domestic Business Corporation), B10310 (Assumed Name (DBA)). Pattern: ^B[0-9]{1,6}$.

formation_date_from.description: Earliest formation / registration date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

formation_date_to.description: Latest formation / registration date, YYYY-MM-DD. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

match.description:
How `name` is matched (the form's Starts With / Contains / Exact Match radios).

Provider reference: allowed values ["starts_with", "contains", "exact"]; default "starts_with".

name.description: Entity, DBA or reservation name text (3 characters or more, as the registry requires).

page.description:
1-based results page (25 rows per page; the registry serves at most 20 pages = 500 rows).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 20; default 1.

principal_name.description: Principal (officer, member, manager) name text, 3 characters or more.

registered_agent_name.description: Registered agent name text, 3 characters or more.

status.description:
Entity status filter (the form's status dropdown: Active, Inactive, Cancelled, Pending).

Provider reference: allowed values ["active", "inactive", "cancelled", "pending"].

200.description:
One page (25 rows) of the registry's Business Entity Search: entities, assumed names (DBAs), registered agents and name reservations matching a name (starts with / contains / exact), an entity number, a principal name or a registered agent name, optionally filtered by status, entity type and formation-date range. Each row carries the registry's internal business_id (and reservation_id for name reservations) for get_entity and get_filing_history, the public entity number, status, status details, type, subtype and file date. A search matching more than 500 records is answered with the registry's first-500 partial mode (capped: true, meta.coverage partial). A search matching nothing is an empty page (count 0).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `capped` | boolean | true when the criteria matched more than 500 records and the registry served only its first 500 (partial mode). |
| `count` | number | Rows on this page. |
| `items_from` | number |  |
| `items_to` | number |  |
| `matched_total` | number | When capped: the number of records the registry said the criteria matched before capping. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number |  |
| `page_count` | number | Pages the registry offers (0 for an empty search). |
| `query` | object |  |
| `results` | object[] |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `total` | number | Records matched as stated by the registry's pager (the first 500 when capped). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
